UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Google user's Doojicar profile with nickname, biometric lock, theme, and oil alert preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Google-authenticated owner.

nickname.description: User display nickname set on first Google sign-in (1-24 chars).

biometricEnabled.description: Whether biometric unlock is active on app launch.

oilAlertEnabled.description: Global toggle for engine oil replacement reminders.

oilAlertThresholdKm.description: Remaining mileage threshold (km) to notify before oil change.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Company.title: Company
Company.description: Company/organization owning one or more fleet vehicles.

code.description: Short 1-20 char emblem label or code.

backgroundPhotoPath.description: Optional local app-private file path of the company card background photo.

backgroundPhotoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG background image in Base64 for cross-device sync.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Vehicle.title: Vehicle
Vehicle.description: Corporate vehicle belonging to a company with parking location/photo, mileage, status, status edit audit, engine oil alert settings, and insurance details.

companyId.description: Document ID of the parent Company.

parkingLocation.description: Current parking bay or location text (0-100 chars).

parkingPhotoPath.description: Optional local app-private file path of the captured parking photo.

parkingPhotoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG thumbnail in Base64 for cross-device sync.

vehiclePhotoPath.description: Optional local app-private file path of the vehicle representative photo.

vehiclePhotoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG representative photo thumbnail in Base64 for cross-device sync.

status.description: Current operational status of the vehicle.

statusUpdatedBy.description: Optional nickname of the user who last modified the vehicle status (1-24 chars).

statusUpdatedAt.description: Optional server timestamp of the last vehicle status update.

lastOilChangeKm.description: Odometer reading at the last engine oil change (km).

oilChangeIntervalKm.description: Engine oil replacement interval in km (1000-50000).

oilAlertEnabled.description: Whether oil replacement alerts are enabled for this vehicle.

insuranceExpiryDate.description: Insurance expiration date string YYYY-MM-DD (0-20 chars).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

MaintenanceRecord.title: MaintenanceRecord
MaintenanceRecord.description: Service and maintenance history entry for a specific vehicle.

vehicleId.description: Document ID of the parent Vehicle.

title.description: Short summary of maintenance work (1-80 chars).

mileageKm.description: Vehicle mileage at time of service (km).

shopName.description: Service center or garage name (0-60 chars).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

VehicleChangeLog.title: VehicleChangeLog
VehicleChangeLog.description: Immutable audit log entry recording who modified a vehicle, when, and exact field-level before/after changes.

vehicleId.description: Document ID of the parent Vehicle.

editorNickname.description: Nickname of the user who performed the modification (1-24 chars).

changes.description: List of concise before/after change strings (1-10 items).

AppReleaseConfig.title: AppReleaseConfig
AppReleaseConfig.description: Shared release version metadata managed by the app distribution admin to notify employees of new updates and link to Firebase App Distribution.

adminUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the release administrator.

latestVersionName.description: Latest published version name such as 1.1 (1-20 chars).

downloadUrl.description: HTTPS download or Firebase App Distribution release link (8-500 chars).

releaseNotes.description: Short summary of what changed in the release (0-300 chars).

forceUpdate.description: Whether the update dialog requires updating without a later button.

updatedBy.description: Nickname of the admin who published the update notice (1-24 chars).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated Google user profile with nickname, biometric settings, theme, and oil alert preferences.

/companies/{companyId}.description: Shared company records visible and editable in real time by all signed-in team members.

/vehicles/{vehicleId}.description: Shared fleet vehicle records visible and editable in real time by all signed-in team members.

/vehicles/{vehicleId}/maintenance/{recor.description: Shared maintenance history records scoped under a specific vehicle.

/vehicles/{vehicleId}/history/{logId}.description: Shared immutable modification audit history scoped under a specific vehicle.

/app_config/release.description: Singleton release update notice readable by signed-in users and writable only by the admin who created it.
